decisions.because: Counterexample on 3c51594 (ROADMAP item 10): a failed read of the STATS map published zeros, a counter reset to Prometheus; the next good read then put the whole history into one window of the rate check and of defense::under_attack, which feeds the storm latch. a_failed_stats_read_keeps_the_last_counters_and_is_counted saw (0, 0, 0) after a failed read.

statement: A failed read of the XDP STATS map is unknown, not zero: the XDP counters, and the rates and the storm attack signal computed from them, keep their last good values, and the failure is counted (sokol_xdp_stats_read_failures_total).
